title: The extended frame (e₀, ιτ_1, …, ιτ_m) is orthonormal
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{P+1} and ι(v) := (0, v_1, …, v_P) ∈ ℝ^{P+1} for v ∈ ℝ^P (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ v))). If τ = (τ_1, …, τ_m) is an orthonormal family in ℝ^P, then τ̃ := (e₀, ιτ_1, …, ιτ_m) (Lean: Fin.cons e₀ (fun i => ι (τ i)) : Fin (m+1) → ℝ^{P+1}) is an orthonormal family in ℝ^{P+1}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (τ : Fin m → Eucl P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Orthonormal ℝ (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 : Eucl (P + 1)) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ (τ i)))) : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl (P + 1))
